release_notes:
• Release v3.1.0 — Multi-Computer Cloud Vault & Reporting Upgrades
• Added Cloud Account Vault: Auto-syncs shop catalog and tickets across computers upon login
• Added direct-to-disk Vector PDF & high-contrast Daylight PNG report exports
• Added individual transaction deletion with automatic inventory stock return
• Added full ticket specification editing and ticket deletion in workbench
• Added automated 180-day ticket lifecycle purge on startup
• Added editable 180-day unclaimed device policy & warranty in settings
• Fixed date comparison bug and eliminated double-counted transactions in ledger
